coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting 18 atomic ground-truth items, 4 have matching information: A100 hardware, shared seed/configuration controls, a no-lookup condition, and task accuracy measurement. This yields 22%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 with an unspecified native long-context model and omits fp16 and all five required memory settings. It does not specify the encoding-plus-decoding versus decoding-only lookup comparison or representative tokens versus mean unit-key representations. Its alternative task battery does not identify Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and the specified QA task. Numerous additional sweeps address a different experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It provides no finding that full memory lookup improves performance, that removing lookup nearly collapses Retrieve.KV accuracy, or that representative token selection outperforms mean representation.
